shortDescription: Ensure Incus profile information is gathered

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert_path).

options.name: client_cert_path
options.description: Client certificate path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key_path). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert).

options.name: client_key
options.description: Client key content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key_path).

options.name: client_key_path
options.description: Client key path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert_path). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the profile to query. If not specified, all profiles in the project are returned.

options.name: server_cert
options.description: Server certificate content for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert_path).

options.name: server_cert_path
options.description: Server certificate path for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert).

options.name: socket_path
options.description: Incus Unix socket path for local connections.

options.name: token
options.description: Token for remote authentication. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(client_cert).

options.name: url
options.description: Remote Incus server URL (e.g. https://host:8443). If specified, connects via HTTPS instead of Unix socket.
